title: Effectivity of P1821, a Novel Tongue Strengthening and Endurance Enhancing Speech Flow Exercise
official: Effectivity of P1821, a Novel Tongue Strengthening and Endurance Enhancing Speech Flow Exercise
summary: The P1821 initiative constitutes an innovative intervention specifically engineered to enhance tongue muscular strength and endurance. The primary objective of this research study is to ascertain whether the integration of a proactive tongue strengthening exercise regimen, utilizing a Non-Significant Risk (NSR) Device, contributes to an observable improvement in speech fluency.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Can read and write
* Willing and able to follow the requirements of the protocol

Exclusion Criteria:

* Previously seen and treated by speech and language pathologist for dysphagia or dysarthria for non-head and neck cancer causes
* Medical instability, restlessness, or other factors that would compromise data acquisition
